tools.name: staking-operations_staking-reward-allocation-audit
tools.description: Calculate staking reward allocations from the supplied commission percent, share percents, penalties, and rounding rule. Share percents must sum to 100%. Commission is that percent of gross rewards or of rewards after penalties. audit_status is balanced, mismatched, invalid, or incomplete. Expected

tools.name: staking-operations_reward-fairness
tools.description: Compare each supplied allocation with the share of the reward pool its weight implies. The rounding error is the total absolute gap, divided by the reward. Equal weights with uneven payouts lower the fairness score. No reward balance is fetched. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/staking-operations/rewa
